recentItems.title: What If the Sunlight Sisters Were the Stars of KPop Demon Hunters?
recentItems.description:
What If the Sunlight Sisters Were the Stars of KPop Demon Hunters?

Be Sure To Subscribe:
https://www.youtube.com/user/channelfrederator?sub_confirmation=1
 
K-Pop Demon Hunters is a series that has a lot of story potential, despite seeming so self-contained, and the reason behind this is because Demon Hunting is a generational thing. HUNTR/X is only the latest generation. But there have been hundreds of years worth of generations that we know so little about. They may have been talked about a bit, sure, but there’s absolutely no information on them outside of a few pop-up scenes. In fact, the only other names we really know of former Demon Hunters are, of course, Celine, and one of her bandmates, Mi-yeong Ryu. But that being said, we don’t even officially know the name of the third sister, let alone what all they really did besides win the International Idol Awards. Well, today, I wanna try and answer that question. To come up with a story surrounding the Sunlight Sisters and what their time may have been like as Demon Hunters. I’m sure we’re all excited to get into that, so without much more to say, we may begin. But just before I do, let me say…

recentItems.title: What If The Saja Boys Won?
recentItems.description:
What If The Saja Boys Won?

Be Sure To Subscribe:
https://www.youtube.com/user/channelfrederator?sub_confirmation=1
 
A somewhat recent hyperfixation of mine has been the K-Pop Demon Hunters. It wasn’t a stretch for me to get into it. For someone who loves J-Rock and J-Pop despite not actually knowing what they’re saying (I’m trying to learn, give me a break), I guess it wasn’t much of a stretch for me to get into this. K-Pop and K-Rock is now slowly seeping into my Youtube playlist. That being said, I like the air of the series, the colors, and the story behind it, which leads to me, as per usual, asking questions about how things might have changed, or what may have happened over here, or over there if certain events did or didn’t happen, and I guess you all reap the rewards of that. Well, one rather large question that I’ve been ruminating on is what would have happened if the Demons had won. And frankly, it was very possible to happen. After all, Rumi was the one who killed Gwi-Ma, and she only did it because Jinu sacrificed his life. But uh… what if he… y’know… didn’t? What if he resisted the urge to completely betray his master? Well, that’s what I wanna see. So grab your… I dunno, your glowsticks. Let’s dive right in. But first…
